content: Uridine phosphorylase 1 is an enzyme encoded by the UPP1 gene in humans. The UPP1 enzyme has been demonstrated to interact with the protein vimentin. An interactive pathway map related to UPP1 can be accessed and edited on WikiPathways under the entry FluoropyrimidineActivity_WP1601. This map allows users to explore connections between genes, proteins, and metabolites by clicking on the respective elements to access detailed articles.
